title: Costa Verde Cottage Vacation Rental
meta_description: Costa Verde Cottage is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionCOSTA VERDE COTTAGERosemary Beach CommunityEast Long Green Road, Rosemary Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights4 bedrooms (see “Room Details” for configurations)4 full baths, 1 half bathSleeps 10 guests2,250 sq. ft.Private pool (can be heated upon request for an additional fee)Downstairs wet bar, wine fridge, and full bath with shower for poolside convenienceOpen galley kitchen with wrap-around quartz counters, farm sink, Viking range, and microwave2-car driveway + 1 vehicle overflow (1 community parking pass issued per home)Four 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb not included; additional rentals available)Welcome to Costa Verde CottageThis beautifully styled 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath home offers luxury and comfort in the heart of Rosemary Beach. With space for up to 10 guests and one of the largest private pools in the area, Costa Verde Cottage provides the perfect blend of location, style, and convenience.Location & LifestyleSituated on East Long Green Road, you’re just steps from the beach, Rosemary Town Center, boutique shops, and restaurants. Overlooking East Long Green Park, the home is perfect for enjoying local events, summer farmers’ markets, or evening strolls.Sleeps, Layout & BedroomsMaster king suite with jetted tub and pool viewsKing guest suite with private bathBunk room with 4 twin beds (ideal for kids or teens)Queen guest bedroomIndoor & Outdoor EntertainingPrivate pool and patio with seating and dining options (pool heating available upon request)Downstairs wet bar + wine fridge and full bath for easy pool accessUpstairs covered balcony overlooking Long Green ParkGourmet open galley kitchen with wrap-around quartz counters, farm sink, Viking gas range, and microwaveAdditional AmenitiesFull-size laundry roomFour adult bikes included seasonallyOutdoor gas fire pit for cool eveningsAmple parking: 2-vehicle driveway + overflowWhy Guests Love Costa Verde CottageCosta Verde Cottage combines private pool luxury, walkability, and spacious design for the ultimate 30A vacation. Enjoy beach days, local dining, biking adventures, or relaxing at home — all in one place. - Nearby Property Recommendation: If you’re traveling with a group, check out Pipers Nest, just steps away.Community AmenitiesFour community pools (some heated seasonally)Private beach accessRosemary Town Square with shopping and diningPlayground, parks, and green spacesOutdoor amphitheaterPedestrian paths and lush landscapingFitness center and racquet club (additional fee)Note: Golf carts are prohibited in Rosemary BeachPool HeatingAvailable Oct–Apr for an additional cost; only operational when outdoor temperatures are between 50°F–80°F.ParkingDesignated 2-car driveway; 1 community parking pass per HOAOn-street parking first-come, first-served with proper permit30A Cottages not liable for fines or towingReservation & Booking Policy50% due at booking; balance due 60 days priorOptional travel insurance availableCancellation: Initial 50% refundable if canceled >60 days before arrival (5% processing fee applies)No smoking, no pets (service animals with documentation permitted)Check-in: 4 PM CST | Check-out: 10 AM CSTGuests must be 25+
